name: InterCode
intro: InterCode 将交互式编程形式化为带执行反馈的状态化循环，并以统一 Docker 框架构建 Bash、SQL 和 Python 三个环境，分别从 NL2Bash、Spider 与 MBPP 转换出 200、1,034 和 117 个任务。
build_method: 统一 POMDP 交互合同；Docker 沙箱；从 NL2Bash、Spider 与 MBPP 转换任务；为三环境实现可执行奖励
metric: Success Rate, Error %, 平均轮数, 连续奖励诊断
modality: 文本, 代码, 结构化数据
task_type: 交互式 Bash, Text-to-SQL, Python 代码生成
eval_feature: 状态化执行反馈, Docker 沙箱, 自定义奖励, 多轮纠错
variant: 原论文 Bash / SQL / Python 三环境
task_type_en: Interactive Bash, Text-to-SQL, Python Code Generation
build_method_en: Unified POMDP interaction contract, Docker sandboxes, task conversion from NL2Bash/Spider/MBPP, and executable environment-specific rewards
eval_feature_en: Stateful Execution Feedback, Docker Sandbox, Custom Rewards, Multi-turn Error Correction
intro_en: InterCode formalizes interactive coding as a stateful execution-feedback loop and implements a unified Docker framework for Bash, SQL, and Python. The paper adapts 200 NL2Bash commands, 1,034 Spider questions, and 117 MBPP problems.
metric_en: Success Rate, Error %, Average Turns, Continuous Reward Diagnostics

drawio_contract_note: The minimum paper artifact contract is Dockerfile plus query/gold data; a custom reward and environment subclass are added only when needed. NL2Bash, Spider, and MBPP are independent external inputs, not outputs of the Docker contract.
drawio_reward_drift_note: The diagram shows paper formulas. The Bash code uses a 0.01 base plus three 0.33 components rather than the paper's 0.34/0.33/0.33 expression; the SQL code multiplies by raw Kendall tau rather than the paper's adjusted (tau+1)/2. Paper validation and model experiments explicitly cover Bash and SQL, not the v3 Python addition.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2306.14898v3 and official Git revision 377bf97b39f51797dfde0d6a163013fdc6222fff, the untagged v1.0.2 milestone. The paper formalizes interactive coding as a POMDP with natural-language instructions, code or submit actions, execution observations, state transitions, and environment-specific rewards. Its modular build contract consists of a Dockerfile, dataset, reward function, and small environment subclass. InterCode-Bash starts from 1,000 NL2Bash commands using at least four utilities, removes unsupported items, grounds filenames and paths, updates obsolete flags, and retains 200 commands split 60/53/60/27 across three custom file systems plus one file-system-agnostic set. Bash reward combines output similarity, file-set changes, and MD5 content correctness. InterCode-SQL converts the 1,034-question Spider development set across 20 databases from SQLite to a unified MySQL initialization dump; its output reward uses record IoU/Jaccard scaled by adjusted Kendall tau for ordering. Gold actions must execute without error and receive reward 1. The paper compares single-turn against maximum-10-turn Try Again, ReAct, and Plan-and-Solve on Bash and SQL, then reports success rate, inadmissible-action Error %, and average turns; these model results and the public web leaderboard are downstream of benchmark construction. The paper defines InterCode-Python with 117 MBPP tasks and proportional unit-test reward, whereas the pinned Git revision contains 974 Python records. Thus the build diagram preserves the paper's 117-task contract, limits the paper model evaluation boundary to Bash and SQL, and excludes the later CTF and SWE environments.
